messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Does metformin work for weight loss?
:
Yes.
Metformin can lead to a modest weight loss.
Results vary.
The weight loss from Metformin is generally smaller than what is seen with medications specifically approved for weight loss.
In the landmark Diabetes Prevention Program (DPP), participants taking metformin lost more weight than those on placebo.
The DPP was a randomized controlled trial in people at high risk for diabetes.
Metformin patients lost 2.7% of body weight after one year.
This was compared to 0.43% for placebo.
Metformin patients also lost 2.1% of body weight after two years.
This was compared to essentially no change (0.02%) for placebo.
29% of people on metformin lost at least 5% of their starting body weight after one year.
Just 13% of people on placebo lost at least 5% of their starting body weight after one year.
This gap held up at the two-year mark.
At the two-year mark, 26% of people on metformin lost at least 5% of their starting body weight.
At the two-year mark, 14% of people on placebo lost at least 5% of their starting body weight.
Triplet: ["Diabetes Prevention Program (DPP)", "is type of study", "randomized controlled trial"]

The relation 'is type of study' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject study is classified as the type of research design specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'is type of': The subject entity is a specific type or category of the object entity.
B. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined or described by the specification provided in the object entity.
C. 'can be differentiated by': The subject entity can be distinguished or identified using the method or test specified by the object entity.
D. 'is one of most widely prescribed': The subject entity is among the most widely prescribed entities of the type specified by the object entity.
E. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
